test_limit_iterator: test the LimitIterator class by wrapping a BltTestIterator and verifying iteration stops at the configured limit
test_limit_iterator_less_than_total: test that LimitIterator yields only the limited number of examples when limit is less than total
test_limit_iterator_equal_to_total: test that LimitIterator yields all examples when limit equals the total number of examples
test_limit_iterator_greater_than_total: test that LimitIterator yields only total examples when limit exceeds the total number of examples
test_limit_iterator_negative_limit: test that LimitIterator yields all examples when limit is set to negative one for unlimited iteration
